description: This file contains functions for preparing, clearing, and retrieving repository settings in a Git-like version control system, including configuration parsing and applying default values.

methods.name: repo_cfg_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is not set.

methods.name: repo_cfg_int
methods.description: Sets an integer configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is not set.

methods.name: repo_cfg_ulong
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is not set.

methods.name: prepare_repo_settings
methods.description: Initializes and applies configuration settings to a repository object based on config values and environment variables.

methods.name: repo_settings_clear
methods.description: Resets the repository settings to default/empty values.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold size for big files in the repository, applying default if unset.

methods.name: repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold size for big files in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_log_all_ref_updates
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for logging all reference updates.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs
methods.description: Returns whether ambiguous refs warning is enabled, initializing settings if needed.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_hooks_path
methods.description: Returns the hooks path for the repository, retrieving from config if not already set.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_shared_repository
methods.description: Returns the shared repository setting, initializing from config if not already set.

methods.name: repo_settings_reset_shared_repository
methods.description: Resets the shared repository configuration to uninitialized state.
